text: Our Scope 1 GHG emissions were 102 million metric tons of CO2e in 2023, down from 109 million in 2022. Scope 2 (market-based) emissions were 8.4 million metric tons CO2e. We aim to achieve net zero by 2050. Total energy consumption was 1,230 GWh in 2023. Renewable electricity accounted for 34% of total energy.

Water withdrawal totaled 4.2 billion m3 in fiscal year 2023. Waste generated reached 1.9 million metric tons, of which 67% was recycled. Scope 3 emissions were estimated at 480 million metric tons of CO2e.
